Landscaping & drainage in Central

The City of Central is its own community northeast of Baton Rouge - family neighborhoods, established homes and larger lots, bordered by the Comite and Amite rivers. That river-adjacent, low-lying ground means drainage and grading come up often, right alongside renovation and year-round maintenance.

Request an estimate Call (225) 324-8252
What we do here

Full-property care for Central homes

Parts of Central sit low near the Comite and Amite, so water is a recurring topic. Regrading yards that pond, tying downspouts into buried pipe and building catch-basin systems to a real outlet is steady work here. Adding topsoil to a wet corner never lasts; reshaping the ground does.

Central’s established homes along Hooper, Sullivan and Greenwell Springs have mature landscaping that has grown past its beds. Renovations that reset the bed lines and plant material, plus recurring maintenance so it stays sharp, are what keep these properties looking their best.

Common problems

What we solve most in Central

River-adjacent low ground

Land near the Comite and Amite ponds easily. We regrade and add drainage to move water off.

Mature, overgrown beds

Established Central homes have outgrown their landscaping. We reset bed lines and plant material.

Whole-property upkeep

Larger lots need a set schedule. We mow, edge and maintain beds year-round.

Central questions

Central FAQs

Do you fix drainage problems in Central?
Yes, and it comes up a lot given how low some of Central sits near the Comite and Amite. We regrade, bury downspouts and run catch basins to a suitable outlet so the yard drains. It starts with a free site visit.
Can you renovate an established yard in Central?
That is some of our favorite work here - resetting overgrown foundation beds, edging and plant material on mature Central properties so they look cared-for again.
Do you offer recurring maintenance on larger Central lots?
Yes. We set a schedule for mowing, edging and bed care sized to the property, billed automatically each month.
What grass grows best in Central yards?
Most Central-area lawns are St. Augustine or centipede, with zoysia on sunnier lots. We match turf and plant material to your light, your soil and how the space is used, and leave after-care instructions so it establishes.
Do you charge for an estimate in Central?
No. Estimates are free with no trip fee and no diagnostic fee. Send a few photos or have us out, and you get a written price with a clearly defined scope, usually the same day.
What other areas near Central do you serve?
Plenty. Along with Central we regularly work Zachary, Baton Rouge, Denham Springs and Watson and much of Greater Baton Rouge and surrounding areas. If you are not sure we reach you, send your address and we will confirm coverage.
